values.note: 2026: $39 a night for county residents and non-residents alike, set by the Dickinson County board; long-term leases at 10-20% off. The county's own pages post no rates and its ResNexus booking page shows a captcha to automated readers, so the figure is from the local newspaper's report of the board's decision.

fees.source: Iron Mountain Daily News, May 2026, https://www.ironmountaindailynews.com/news/local-news/2026/05/camper-questions-lake-antoine-price-increase/ ('Earlier this year, the board set camping fees at $39 per night for both residents and nonresidents. Long-term leases are available as well, at discounts ranging from 10% to 20%.'), read 2026-10-22 (secondary: newspaper report of the county board's decision)

booking.source: https://www.dickinsoncountymi.gov/government/county_departments/parks/index.php ('Reserve a campsite' linking to the county's ResNexus booking page), read 2026-10-22

note: Dickinson County park on Lake Antoine with a beach, boat launch and swimming. Operates Memorial Day through Labor Day. --Claude
summary: County park pages read: reservations online via the county's ResNexus page (captcha to automated readers), phone 906-774-8875 confirmed (N3393 Quinnesec Lake Antoine Rd).
